label: CAN_BE_OTHERWISE_2: CanBeOtherwise x r: x CAN_BE_OTHERWISE_2 in respect r
term: can be otherwise (ἐνδέχεται ἄλλως ἔχειν; aliter et aliter se habere)
definition: `CanBeOtherwise x r`: x can be otherwise in respect r. Metaphysics XII.7, 1072b4-8 says that what is moved can be otherwise, the first heaven in place though not in substance, and that the unmoved mover cannot be otherwise in any way; Aquinas counts the respects as substance, quantity, quality and place (In Metaph. XII, lect. 7 n. 12). A Lean primitive: it is not defined from act, potency or CanFailToBe, and no modal semantics is encoded. It is related to CanFailToBe only by the unattributed bridge STMT-WHAT-CAN-FAIL-TO-BE-CAN-BE-OTHERWISE. In Metaph. V, lect. 6 n. 14 relates it to being able to be in more ways (STMT-WHAT-CAN-BE-IN-MORE-WAYS-CAN-BE-OTHERWISE). Aquinas also gives the necessary as what cannot be otherwise (V, lect. 6 n. 6 and n. 14; Met. V.5, 1015a33-35).
